items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.desc: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.desc: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Nine-Day Inflow Streak as Ethereum Funds Extend Their Run
items.desc: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201.9 million on Aug. 28, ending a nine-day inflow run, even as Ethereum funds extended a 10-day streak with fresh cash.

items.title: Strategy’s Bitcoin Is $2.8 Billion in Profit—Is Saylor Teeing Up a Buy?
items.desc: A Bitcoin rally to around $79,000 lifted the company's 840,447 BTC roughly $2.8 billion above its cost basis, as Saylor's "We're Back" post fueled speculation that Strategy may resume buying.

items.title: Crypto.com-linked Cronos network halts after Tectonic exploit estimated at $75 million
items.desc: Li says the attacker manipulated the price of Tectonic's illiquid TONIC token before borrowing against the inflated collateral, a Mango Markets-style hack.

items.title: Saylor signals Strategy is ‘Back’ to Bitcoin buying
items.desc: Michael Saylor’s “We’re Back” post hints Strategy may resume Bitcoin buying after a two-month pause to strengthen its balance sheet.

items.title: Chainalysis accuses ICE of unfairly steering $95 million blockchain contract to TRM Labs
items.desc: The lawsuit asks a federal court to block the $95 million TRM contract and require ICE to conduct a full and open competition.

items.title: From Hawala to Swift: Inside the 1,000-year battle to move money safely
items.desc: Finance has spent centuries decoupling wealth from physical transport, but constantly erasing friction creates vectors for increasingly high-tech exploits.

items.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
items.desc: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

items.title: Crypto market makers are cashing in on bitcoin's rally - without betting on direction
items.desc: As bitcoin surges back above $80,000, sophisticated trading firms are quietly collecting yield rather than making directional bet.

items.title: Russia’s Sber eyes USDT loans, questions digital ruble demand
items.desc: Russia’s largest bank, Sber, plans to accept USDT and Ether alongside Bitcoin as loan collateral as the country introduces regulated crypto trading under a new law.

items.title: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halts mainnet after attacker receives 400 million FOGO tokens, 10% of circulating supply
items.desc: The affected tokens make up about 4% of FOGO's genesis supply and were worth about $3 million at the time of the incident.

items.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
items.desc: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

items.title: Cosmos Labs says it wrongly cleared the bug behind a $5.7 million six-chain hack
items.desc: MANTRA Chain, which lost $3.6 million, claimed the patch was only released 20 hours before the attack began and did not identify the flaw it fixed.

items.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
items.desc: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

items.desc: Galaxy Research shows coins untouched for 10-plus years moving at an unusual pace in 2026, with six ancient wallets shifting $40 million in a single 10-day stretch this month.

items.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
items.desc: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

items.title: Inside the high-stakes battle between digital dollars and Swift's massive money engine
items.desc: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

items.title: BitGo Buys NYDIG's Institutional Trading Arm to Beef Up Derivatives and Financing
items.desc: The roughly $42.5 million cash-and-stock deal adds derivatives, structured products and capital-markets capabilities, while letting NYDIG focus on its power and data-center business.

items.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows

items.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
items.desc: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

items.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million worth of coins
items.desc: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.
